title: evaluating the impact of backbone networks and input resolution on forearm acupoint localization
core_idea: Investigate how different deep learning backbone models and image input resolutions affect the accuracy and consistency of localizing five clinically important forearm acupoints using a top-down pose estimation framework, benchmarking multiple backbones across several resolutions and evaluating performance with normalized Euclidean distance and its standard deviation.
tldr: Benchmark study of backbone architectures and image resolutions for precise localization of five forearm acupoints using a top-down pose estimation approach, evaluated with normalized Euclidean distance to inform clinical keypoint detection design choices.
